remarks: Location, Location, Location! Enjoy the convenience of downtown Greenwich and one floor living at Putnam Hill. This bright, top floor corner apartment offers desirable western exposure, filling the home with natural light throughout the day. The spacious layout includes a generous living room & dining areas that open to the expanded kitchen and private balcony. Featuring an ensuite primary bedroom plus 2 addl. bedrooms & bath. Hardwood floors throughout & laundry is located within the unit. You'll appreciate a secure lobby entrance, and additional storage. Pet friendly with restrictions - one cat or one dog, 24 lb. max. On-Site Super. Buyer pays a one time capital asses of .5% of sale price at closing. Garage parking as avail @ $85/month. Pet friendly w/restrictions. A great community close to shopping, dining & transportation.
